Wooded Foothills/sacrifice-fetches-a-for: The printed card says 'Search your library for a Mountain or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle', and every other corpus card that searches for a land onto the battlefield (e.g. Rampant Growth) carries Tapped$ True; the pinned Forge script for Wooded Foothills (and all ten original fetchlands) has a ChangeZone with Destination$ Battlefield and no Tapped$ True, and its Oracle: line omits 'tapped' too. gorge faithfully implements the script, so the fetched Forest enters untapped (observed tapped=false). Upstream script/corpus defect: cannot be fixed by committing a script (GPL-3.0); report upstream or bump FORGE_REF. Triage: for the ten original fetchlands the correct fix is Tapped$ True on the search's ChangeZone.
Mirror Entity/effect-expires-and-types-r: The {X} 'until end of turn' effect (base power and toughness X/X plus all creature types, CR 613.3c, 611.3a) persists past the end-of-turn cleanup: at the next turn's main phase the Bears are still 4/4 carrying every creature type (incl. Dragon) and Mirror Entity itself is still 4/4. The {X} pump itself is correct while it lasts (the sibling scenario pins it), so the divergence is the expiry of activated-ability-registered continuous effects specifically (effectUntilEOT in effects/misc.go vs the AGENTS.md Effect row that claims absent-Duration$ expires correctly).
Mild-Mannered Librarian/a-new-librarian-: CR 400.7/602.5b: 'Activate only once' is tied to the object; a Librarian returned to hand and recast is a new object (1/1 Human, no counters - asserted and passing) whose ability can be activated. Observed: with {3}{G} in the pool the activation is not offered, i.e. the once-only use survives the zone change (the card keeps its identity across zones). Found by the FDN audit batch 4; no ticket yet.
Tinybones, Bauble Burglar/stashed-land-c: CR 116.2a/110.2: the player who plays a land puts it onto the battlefield, and a permanent's controller is the player under whose control it entered. Expected: the opponent's stashed Forest, played from exile by Tinybones's controller, is on that player's battlefield. Observed: 'Play Forest' is offered and taken, but the land enters under its OWNER's control (count p0 battlefield Forest = 0, p1 = 1), so the player who spent their land drop cannot tap it. The sibling cast passes (a stashed creature card enters under the caster's control), so the gap is the land-play path for a land the player does not own. New root, found by the FDN audit batch 5; no ticket yet.
Chandra, Flameshaper/plus-two-chosen-car: The +2 exiles the top three cards, its controller chooses one and may play it this turn (CR 601.3). Expected: the chosen Lightning Bolt is castable from exile with the {R}{R}{R} the ability added. Observed: the mana is added, the three cards are exiled and the choice is posed and answered (the sibling plus-two-adds-three-red-and-exiles-three passes), but no cast of the chosen card is offered. Likely the known root of Strongbox Raider/attacked-exiles-two-and-the-chosen-card-is-castable: the may-play permission for a card chosen from among freshly exiled cards is never granted.
Chandra, Flameshaper/plus-two-unchosen-c: Expected the chosen Lightning Bolt to be offered and the two unchosen exiled cards not. Observed: none is offered (the unchosen half holds). Same root as plus-two-chosen-card-is-castable-this-turn.
Chandra, Flameshaper/plus-two-chosen-lan: Expected the chosen exiled Forest to be playable as the turn's land drop. Observed: the play is not offered. Same root as plus-two-chosen-card-is-castable-this-turn.
